title: Property Credit and Spa Entitlements of the Hotel Rate Plans Range
content:
Property credit held against a reservation, the term within which it must be spent, who may spend it, and the discount carried on spa treatments are contracted plan by plan across the Hotel Rate Plans range.

| Rate plan | Property credit, per stay | Credit validity, calendar days from arrival | Companion may spend the credit | Spa discount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0.00 USD | 0 | no | 0 percent |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0.00 USD | 0 | no | 0 percent |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0.00 USD | 0 | no | 5 percent |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 25.00 USD | 3 | no | 10 percent |
| Member Flex Rate | 50.00 USD | 5 | yes | 15 percent |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 100.00 USD | 7 | yes | 20 percent |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 200.00 USD | 10 | yes | 25 percent |

The first money column is the property credit included in the rate plan and held against the reservation for use on site. The validity column is the number of calendar days from check-in within which that credit must be spent. The third column records whether the credit may be spent by a companion in the same room. The last column is the percentage discount on spa treatments booked during the stay.

*Reading the validity term, hypothetical dates.* On the Suite Flexible Rate, whose validity term is 7 calendar days, a guest arriving on the 3rd of a month may spend the credit up to and including the 10th. On the Standard Flexible Rate, whose term is 3 days, the same arrival gives the 6th. Three plans of the range carry 0.00 USD of credit and a validity term of 0 days: the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, the Advance Purchase 21 Rate and the Semi-Flexible Rate.
